title: Thapa2025: Freewill reach-and-grasp motor-execution dataset from Thapa et al. 2025
description: A BIDS-formatted EEG dataset of self-paced (freewill) reach-and-grasp motor execution from 23 healthy right-handed participants across 49 sessions. On each trial, participants freely chose one of four cups (two water-filled, two empty) and the timing of their movement, yielding 6808 trials in four classes. The dataset was recorded with a 31-channel scalp EEG system plus EOG and auxiliary channels, and supports brain-machine interface research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz with a Brain Products actiCHamp Plus amplifier and actiCAP snap active gel electrodes (31 EEG channels, 4 EOG, plus accelerometer and audio cue channels), referenced to Cz. Participants performed self-paced reach-and-grasp movements toward one of four cups, with audio cues marking the start and end of each trial. Each session comprised 5 runs.
